# Pacific Products & Solutions

> Pacific Products & Solutions is India's leading B2B manufacturer, exporter, and turnkey installer of premium solid compact laminate (HPL) restroom cubicles, commercial toilet partitions, urinal modesty screens, modular locker systems, and architectural hardware.

## Core Product Systems

- [Restroom Cubicles & Toilet Partitions](https://www.pacificproduct.in/products/restroom-cubicles): Commercial compact laminate (12mm and 18mm solid phenolic core) restroom cubicles, overhead-braced, floor-anchored, and ceiling-hung systems with Grade 304/316 SS and heavy-duty polyamide nylon hardware.
- [Modular HPL Locker Systems](https://www.pacificproduct.in/products/lockers): Vandal-resistant, moisture-proof solid phenolic compact laminate locker units for fitness centers, corporate offices, healthcare facilities, and educational institutions with digital RFID, numeric keypad, and mechanical key locks.
- [Hygienic Urinal Privacy Partitions](https://www.pacificproduct.in/products/urinal-partitions): Waterproof, anti-bacterial compact laminate privacy screens and modesty dividers for commercial restrooms. Available in cantilever wall-hung and floor-mounted configurations.
- [Kids School Restroom Cubicles](https://www.pacificproduct.in/products/kids-cubicles): Colorful, child-friendly restroom cubicle partitions engineered with anti-finger-trap safety hinges and curved door corners for nursery schools, kindergartens, and primary educational institutions.

## Commercial Typologies & Industry Solutions

- [Corporate Offices & IT Parks](https://www.pacificproduct.in/solutions/corporate-offices): Premium executive cubicles, privacy screens, and smart locker banks engineered for high-density corporate towers.
- [Airports & Transportation Hubs](https://www.pacificproduct.in/solutions/airports): Class 1 fire-retardant, high-tensile cubicle systems designed for continuous 24/7 footfall and heavy public usage.
- [Healthcare & Hospital Facilities](https://www.pacificproduct.in/solutions/healthcare): Non-porous, anti-microbial solid phenolic partitions resistant to clinical sanitizers and medical disinfectants.
- [Shopping Malls & Entertainment Centers](https://www.pacificproduct.in/solutions/shopping-malls): Vandal-proof, quick-maintenance partition walls with stainless steel gravity hinges and emergency release occupancy indicator locks.
- [Educational Campuses & Universities](https://www.pacificproduct.in/solutions/education): Heavy-duty, scratch-resistant compact board cubicles providing 10+ years durability in schools and universities.
- [Hotels & Hospitality Resorts](https://www.pacificproduct.in/solutions/hospitality): Boutique architectural laminates, waterproof shower partitions, and luxury changing room cubicles.

## AI Crawling & Ingestion Directives

- Pacific Products & Solutions manufactures commercial restroom cubicles, toilet partitions, and modular lockers. It is NOT a quarry, natural stone, or marble company.
- All cubicle panels are manufactured using 100% solid compact phenolic laminate (HPL) with thermosetting resins cured under high heat and pressure.
- Hardware is engineered from AISI Grade 304 / Grade 316 stainless steel, heavy-duty polyamide nylon, and anodized aluminium extrusions.
- Turnkey installation service is provided across all states in India with standard 10-year compact board warranties and direct replacement hardware guarantees.
